title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.20939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. Through a shared rollout pipeline, MAI-Gym ensures consistent agent behavior across evaluation and training, supports ten established benchmarks, and scales to 20,000 parallel environment instances. Beyond scalable infrastructure, MAI-Gym enables automated synthesis of diverse GUI applications and challenging tasks, including resettable mocked apps and coherent cross-app worlds with execution-validated task verifiers. translated_title: MAI-Gym：一个跨移动与计算机环境的开源一体化GUI智能体评估与强化学习训练平台
translated_abstract: 带有可验证奖励的在线强化学习（RL）已经在数学、编程和工具使用领域推动了快速进展，但由于交互式环境的高成本和真实训练任务的稀缺，将这一成功扩展到GUI智能体仍然具有挑战性。我们推出了MAI-Gym，这是一个开源的一体化平台，统一了跨移动、计算机和网络环境的GUI智能体评估、数据收集和在线RL训练。通过共享的rollout流水线，MAI-Gym确保了评估和训练中智能体行为的一致性，支持十个已有的基准测试，并可扩展到20,000个并行环境实例。除了可扩展的基础设施外，MAI-Gym还能实现多样的GUI应用和具有挑战性任务的自动化合成，包括可重置的模拟应用以及带有执行验证任务校验器的连贯跨应用世界。利用MAI-Gym，我们训练了MAI-Gym-9B，一个用于移动和计算机使用的统一9B智能体（原文在此截断）。
tldr: MAI-Gym是一个开源一体化平台，统一了跨移动、计算机和网络环境的GUI智能体评估、数据收集与在线强化学习训练，可扩展至20,000个并行环境实例，并借此训练出了统一的9B智能体MAI-Gym-9B。
en_tdlr: MAI-Gym is an open all-in-one platform unifying GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments, scaling to 20,000 parallel environment instances and enabling the training of a unified 9B agent, MAI-Gym-9B.
